data_description.notify: Notification actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. The minutes are set per room.

demand.title: Heating demand
demand.description:
Optional: per thermostat an entity that says how much it heats – a percentage (e.g. the heating power of a cloud integration) or an on/off value (e.g. a threshold helper on a pipe sensor). Tado X reports neither its valve nor its demand over Matter, so thermostats without one show no heating status.

thermostat_unconfirmed.title: {thermostat} does not take its setting
thermostat_unconfirmed.description:
The room {room} sent {thermostat} a new setting more than 30 minutes ago, and the thermostat has not reported it back. It is probably hard to reach in the Thread network, or its batteries are low.

The integration sends the setting again when the thermostat reconnects or reports; this message goes away once it confirms.
